control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit - electrical exposure at P-3221

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-3221 and M-3221 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 28 April 2004 a near hit was recorded on P-3221 and M-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
